data_objects.name: income_bin_records
data_objects.meaning: Row-level income values paired with an integer raw-bin code.

variables.name: raw_bin
variables.meaning: Integer categorical or ordinal bin code with observed values 0 through 7.

variables.name: inc
variables.meaning: Nullable income amount represented by a small set of numeric levels.

structure.description: Each row pairs one raw bin assignment with an income level; no row identifier or time field is present.

uncertainties: The income currency, time basis, and exact construction or ordering of raw_bin are not supplied.
annotation_notes: Blank inc fields represent missing income; raw_bin remains populated for those rows.
